products.name: AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case
products.tagline: AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case – Key Features & Specifications Experience immersive sound, Active Noise Cancellation and effortless everyday listening with AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case.
products.description: AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case – Key Features & Specifications Experience immersive sound, Active Noise Cancellation and effortless everyday listening with AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. Designed with Apple's H2 headphone chip and a redesigned acoustic architecture, AirPods 5 combines powerful audio performance, intelligent listening features and a comfortable open-ear design. The Wireless Charging Case adds convenient charging options, a built-in speaker for Find My and longer listening time, making AirPods 5 a versatile choice for music, calls, entertainment and everyday use. Active Noise Cancellation: Helps reduce unwanted environmental noise for a more focused listening experience. Up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation: AirPods 5 provide up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation. H2 headphone chip: Powers advanced audio features and intelligent listening experiences. Redesigned acoustic architecture: Designed to deliver richer and more detailed sound. Adaptive Audio: Automatically blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency based on your surroundings. Transparency mode: Lets you hear your surroundings more naturally while listening. Conversation Awareness: Automatically lowers the media volume when you start speaking and restores it after your conversation. Personalised Spatial Audio: Creates a more immersive listening experience with dynamic head tracking. Adaptive EQ: Automatically adjusts the sound to your ears. Voice Isolation: Helps make your voice clearer during calls. Live Translation: Helps with communication across supported languages when paired with a compatible Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone. Siri AI: Provides hands-free access to Siri on a compatible iPhone. Force sensor with volume swipe: Swipe up or down to adjust volume directly from AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. Wireless Charging Case: Supports charging with a USB-C connector, Apple Watch charger or Qi-certified charger. Find My support: The charging case includes a built-in speaker to help locate it. IP57 rating: AirPods 5 are dust, sweat and water resistant. Up to 5 hours of listening time: Get up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. Up to 22 hours with the charging case: The Wireless Charging Case provides up to 22 hours of total battery life with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. Bluetooth 5.3: Provides wireless connectivity with compatible devices. AirPods 5 Audio and Sound Quality AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case are designed to deliver a detailed and immersive listening experience. The combination of a custom high-excursion Apple driver, custom high-dynamic-range amplifier, redesigned acoustic architecture and Adaptive EQ helps produce rich and balanced audio. The open-ear design is designed for comfortable everyday listening, while Active Noise Cancellation helps reduce unwanted background sounds. Active Noise Cancellation AirPods 5 bring Active Noise Cancellation to an open-ear design. According to Apple, AirPods 5 offer up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation. This makes AirPods 5 suitable for listening to music, podcasts and other audio when you want to reduce surrounding distractions. Adaptive Audio Adaptive Audio combines Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency in real time. It automatically adjusts the level of noise control according to your surroundings, helping you stay connected to what is happening around you while enjoying your audio. Transparency Mode Transparency lets you hear your surroundings while continuing to listen to your content. It is useful when you want to remain aware of conversations, announcements or your environment without removing your AirPods. Conversation Awareness Conversation Awareness detects when you begin speaking and automatically lowers the volume of your media. Once your conversation ends, your audio can return to its previous level. Personalised Spatial Audio AirPods 5 support Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking. This creates a more immersive sound experience for compatible music, movies, TV shows and other supported content. AirPods 5 H2 Chip AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case feature Apple's H2 headphone chip. The H2 chip helps power advanced audio capabilities including Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, Transparency, Voice Isolation, Siri features and other intelligent listening experiences. AirPods 5 for Calls and Communication AirPods 5 are designed for more natural communication during calls and everyday conversations. The earbuds feature dual beamforming microphones, an inward-facing microphone, an optical in-ear sensor, motion-detecting and speech-detecting accelerometers, and a force sensor. Voice Isolation Voice Isolation is designed to help make your voice clearer during calls by focusing on your voice and reducing unwanted background noise. Siri and Siri Interactions With compatible Apple devices, you can use Siri hands-free to perform tasks such as playing music, making calls or getting directions. AirPods 5 also support Siri Interactions, allowing supported head movements to respond to Siri prompts for actions such as answering calls, hearing messages and managing notifications. AirPods 5 Live Translation AirPods 5 support Live Translation, powered by Apple Intelligence, to help users communicate across supported languages when paired with a compatible Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone. Apple lists support for selected languages and regions, including English & other languages support. Availability can vary depending on language, region and compatible software. AirPods 5 Wireless Charging Case The Wireless Charging Case is one of the key differences between the standard AirPods 5 and this model. The case supports multiple charging options: USB-C charging Apple Watch charger Qi-certified chargers The case also includes a built-in speaker for Find My, making it easier to locate the charging case when needed. AirPods 5 Battery Life AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case provide longer listening time compared with the standard AirPods 5. Up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. Up to 22 hours of total listening time with the Wireless Charging Case and Active Noise Cancellation enabled. A 5-minute charge provides around 1 hour of listening time. Battery life varies depending on usage, settings, environment and other factors. AirPods 5 Design and Comfort AirPods 5 feature Apple's open-ear design, making them suitable for comfortable everyday listening. Each AirPod weighs approximately 4.3 grams, while the AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case have a total weight of approximately 34.7 grams. The compact design makes AirPods 5 convenient to carry throughout the day, whether you are commuting, working, studying or relaxing. AirPods 5 Water and Dust Resistance AirPods 5 have an IP57 rating for dust, sweat and water resistance. This provides additional protection for everyday use and activities where the AirPods may be exposed to sweat or moisture. Water and dust resistance can decrease with normal wear over time. AirPods 5 Connectivity AirPods 5 support Bluetooth 5.3 wireless technology for connecting with compatible devices. They work with compatible iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Apple TV models. AirPods can also function as Bluetooth headphones with non-Apple devices, although some features may be limited. AirPods 5 Controls AirPods 5 provide convenient controls for everyday use. Press once to play or pause media. Press once to answer a call or mute/unmute. Press once for supported camera remote functionality. Press twice to end a call. Press twice to skip forward. Press three times to skip back. Press and hold to switch between listening modes. Swipe up or down on AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case to adjust volume. Use Siri for hands-free control. Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode — which lets you comfortably hear and interact with the world around you exactly as it sounds —to provide the best listening experience in any environment. And when you’re speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume ofwhat’s playing.IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY — Voice Isolation improves the quality of calls in loud conditions. And with Siri Interactions, now you can respond to Siri by simply nodding your head yes or shaking your head no. Pair AirPods 4 by simply placing them near your device and tapping Connect on your screen. Easily share a song or show between two sets of AirPods. A skin-detecting sensor knows to play audio only when you’re wearing AirPods and pauses when you take them off. And you can track down your AirPods and Charging Case with the Find My app.PERSONALISED SPATIAL AUDIO — Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, creating a theatre-like listening experience for music, TV shows, movies, games and more.REDESIGNED CASE — The Charging Case is the smallest in the industry with wireless charging. Charge with an Apple Watch charger, USB-C Charge Cable or Qi-certified charger.LONG BATTERY LIFE — With Active Noise Cancellation enabled, get up to 4 hours of listening time on a single charge and up to 20 hours using the case. And you can get up to 30 hours of total listening time without Active Noise Cancellation enabled.DUST, SWEAT AND WATER RESISTANT — AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat and water resistant, so they’ll withstand rain and heavy workouts.
